verdict.rationale: CIPO's own pages document downloadable bulk data ('IP Horizons – Bulk data', 'Canadian IP databases and downloadable bulk data') and patent record downloads, which give a bulk read/export path across many records. The evidence consists only of link titles, and no bulk write actions are shown; filing, renewal and amendment appear to be per-item online services. Missing for 10: bulk filing/renewal/amendment across many applications, documented batch or API-driven operations, details on bulk data format and scope, independent or hands-on corroboration.
